inputs.original_text: DSD athletes also face exclusion from future Olympics IOC says move will protect fairness and safety’ The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text:
Common sense and basic reality have finally prevailed, thanks to the International Olympic Committee and its president Kirsty Coventry. It is about time our institutions stood up for the sacred integrity of women's sports and the safety of our female athletes. 

As Coventry rightly stated, "It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category." This landmark decision to ban transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games proves that the radical progressive push to erase biological reality and undermine womanhood has hit a wall. We have a fundamental duty to protect our daughters, preserve traditional categories, and ensure fair competition, rather than sacrificing the pillars of natural order and common decency on the altar of modern ideology.
